description: Search APM spans/traces for performance analysis. Filter by service, resource, status, duration

extractFields.description: Comma-separated dotted paths to project from response (e.g. 'id,name,owner.name,columns.*.name'). Use `*` as wildcard for arrays/objects. Wrap field names with dots in backticks. Reduces response tokens dramatically on large entities.

from.description: Start time (ISO 8601 or relative). Example: 2026-02-26T00:00:00Z or now-1h

query.description: Span search query. Example: service:api-server resource_name:GET_/users @duration:>5s

sort.description: Sort order: -timestamp (newest first) or timestamp (oldest first)

to.description: End time (ISO 8601 or relative). Example: 2026-02-26T23:59:59Z or now

name: search-spans
